description: Feature 2 — Adaptive recommendation that learns from fasting history. NEW pure src/lib/adaptive.ts producing a nullable, typed suggestion from history + chosenMethod + profiling, with emoji-free Gojek copy. Deterministic (inject now; no Date.now() in core). ADDITIVE dismissible 'Saran buat kamu' card on Home and/or Stats that does NOT replace the profiling+BMI recommendation and does NOT auto-change the method (tap navigates to Plan Picker; user confirms). CRITICAL: every suggested method respects the recommendation safety invariants — import canOfferAggressive; cap step-ups at 18:6 unless aggressive-eligible; never suggest 20:4/omad otherwise; never level a heavy exerciser into aggression. Depends on FEAT-001 only for the shared foundation; logic depends on existing recommendation.ts/stats.ts.
steps: Read FIRST: the absolute context.json and this file, plus src/lib/recommendation.ts (canOfferAggressive, R1 heavy guard) and src/lib/stats.ts (streaks/totals). Do not weaken any invariant.

Create framework-free src/lib/adaptive.ts (NO React, NO @/db): define the safe ladder `const LADDER: MethodId[] = ["14:10", "16:8", "18:6"]` and import canOfferAggressive from @/lib/recommendation, streaks from @/lib/stats, types from @/types, copy from @/lib/copy. Export `interface AdaptiveSuggestion { kind: "level_up" | "ease_down" | "streak"; fromMethod?: MethodId; toMethod?: MethodId; message: string }` and `suggestAdaptive(input: { history: FastingSessionRecord[]; chosenMethod: MethodId; profiling: ProfilingAnswers | null; now: number }): AdaptiveSuggestion | null`.

Implement suggestAdaptive rules (deterministic, messages from copy.adaptive): (a) empty/short history (e.g. < 3 recent sessions) -> return null; (b) consistent completion (high completed-ratio over a recent window) and chosenMethod is on the LADDER below 18:6 -> level_up to the NEXT ladder step; if the next step would be stricter than 18:6, only emit it (20:4) when canOfferAggressive(profiling) is true (and profiling is non-null), otherwise CAP at 18:6 (no suggestion if already at cap); NEVER emit omad as toMethod and NEVER cross into 20:4/omad when profiling is null or canOfferAggressive is false; (c) frequent early stops (low completed-ratio) -> ease_down one ladder step (never below 14:10); (d) healthy current streak with no clear level signal -> kind 'streak' encouragement, no method change (fromMethod/toMethod omitted). A heavy exerciser (exercises && intensity==='heavy') must NEVER be leveled into aggression — rely on canOfferAggressive being false for them; add an explicit guard/test.

src/lib/copy.ts: add a `adaptive` namespace with emoji-free Gojek messages for level_up, ease_down, and streak (templated phrasing that can mention from/to method labels), plus the card title 'Saran buat kamu' and the CTA label (e.g. 'Lihat metode').
src/types/index.ts + src/components/ui/Icon.tsx: add IconKey `suggestion` mapped to verified io5 `IoSparklesOutline` (keep `satisfies`).

Create src/features/adaptive/AdaptiveCard.tsx ('use client'): useLiveQuery for history (db.sessions...toArray()), read chosenMethod + profiling from useAppStore, call suggestAdaptive({ history, chosenMethod, profiling, now: Date.now() }); render nothing when it returns null; otherwise an ADDITIVE dismissible Card (local dismiss state) with the message and, for level_up/ease_down, a Button that navigates to /profile (Plan Picker) WITHOUT changing the method — the user confirms there. Icons via the choke point.

Mount <AdaptiveCard/> on Home (src/features/timer/FastingTimer.tsx, below StageIndicator) and/or Stats (src/features/stats/StatsOverview.tsx). It must coexist with — not replace — the existing profiling+BMI recommendation surfaces.

Create src/lib/__tests__/adaptive.test.ts covering: level_up on consistent success; step-up CAP at 18:6 for a non-aggressive-eligible user; step-up allowed to 20:4 ONLY when canOfferAggressive is true; ease_down on frequent early stops (never below 14:10); streak encouragement with no method change; empty/short history -> null; null profiling -> no aggressive suggestion; heavy exerciser is never leveled into 20:4/omad. Assert the invariant directly: for every produced suggestion with a toMethod of 20:4/omad, canOfferAggressive(profiling) is true.
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/adaptive.ts is React-free, deterministic (now injected), and returns AdaptiveSuggestion | null.
No suggestion ever emits 20:4/omad as toMethod unless canOfferAggressive(profiling) is true; step-ups cap at 18:6 otherwise; a heavy exerciser is never leveled into aggression (tested).
The adaptive card is additive + dismissible, does NOT replace the profiling+BMI recommendation, and does NOT auto-change the method (navigates to Plan Picker only).
`npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/adaptive.test.ts` passes including all safety-cap cases.
`npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `npm run build` succeeds, no-emoji scan green.
findings:
Implemented the pure, React-free, deterministic src/lib/adaptive.ts (now injected; no Date.now in core). Exposes AdaptiveSuggestion + suggestAdaptive. Ladder LADDER=['14:10','16:8','18:6']; rules: <3 recent sessions -> null; completed-ratio>=0.8 over the last 5 -> level_up one ladder step; ease-ratio<=0.4 -> ease_down one step (floored at 14:10); otherwise a healthy current streak (>=3) -> 'streak' encouragement (no method change); else null.

SAFETY: imports canOfferAggressive from recommendation.ts and streaks from stats.ts. Step-ups cap at 18:6; the single aggressive step to 20:4 is reachable ONLY when profiling is non-null AND canOfferAggressive(profiling) is true; omad is NEVER a toMethod.

IMPORTANT nuance discovered: exerciseState maps intensity 'heavy' -> 'none', so canOfferAggressive returns TRUE at the predicate level for a heavy weight-loss user. Relying on canOfferAggressive alone would therefore level a heavy exerciser into 20:4. To honor the invariant 'never level a heavy exerciser into aggression', nextStepUp carries an EXPLICIT isHeavyExerciser guard in addition to canOfferAggressive. Tests assert this directly (the heavy exerciser never gets a 20:4/omad toMethod and gets no level_up past 18:6). Did NOT weaken recommendation.ts — its 61 tests stay green.

UI: added IconKey 'suggestion' -> IoSparklesOutline (Icon.tsx keeps satisfies); added copy.adaptive (emoji-free Gojek, templated level_up/ease_down + cardTitle/cta/dismiss). Created src/features/adaptive/AdaptiveCard.tsx ('use client'): useLiveQuery(db.sessions.toArray()), reads chosenMethod+profiling from the store, injects Date.now(), renders nothing on null/dismiss, additive dismissible Card, and for level_up/ease_down a button that only router.push('/profile') (Plan Picker) — never auto-changes the method. Mounted below StageIndicator on Home (FastingTimer) and after WeightSummaryCard on Stats (StatsOverview); it coexists with (does not replace) the profiling+BMI recommendation.

Verification: npx vitest run (221 passed, up from 205; no-emoji scan 79), npx tsc --noEmit clean, npm run build succeeds (SW generated), npm run lint 0 errors (2 pre-existing warnings in untouched files). Layout files untouched.
